purpose: Teach: 富豪/調教/落胆/軍部/反感/進入/出没/盗作

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、近代の富豪たちの慈善活動を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura — you wrote your paper on the charitable activities of wealthy people in the modern era, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, inviting. Measured pace. A gentle confirmation, not interrogation. The tone of a teacher who already knows the answer and is giving the student space to speak.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の馬の調教史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the history of horse training during wartime.
lines.style: Straightforward, respectful. Direct eye contact in the voice. No apology for the unexpected answer — just clear statement. Slight pause after the affirmative.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 敗戦時の国民の落胆を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: I see — and you chose the subject of national despair at the time of defeat?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Slightly slower pace. The tone of someone working through a pattern they're beginning to notice. Genuine curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、軍部の独走による戦争への道を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on how the military's overreach led the nation toward war.
lines.style: Firm but not defensive. Slightly faster than before. She's stating her work with growing confidence. No hedging.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政策への反感を生む要因を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the factors that generate public resistance to policy — that was your focus?
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly in the voice. Engaged, nearly conversational now. The teacher is following the thread. A touch of realization dawning.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、国境を進入する不法移民を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on undocumented immigrants crossing borders.
lines.style: Steady, unflinching. Same clarity as before. She's watching to see if the teacher will draw the connection. A subtle shift — she's waiting.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 海賊が出没した時代を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: The era when piracy was prevalent — that's what you examined?
lines.style: Quieter now, the realization fully landing. Slower. A slight wonder in the delivery. The teacher has understood what Sakura has been doing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、学術界の盗作問題を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on plagiarism in the academic world.
lines.style: Close, nearly whispered. Final. She's made her point. A small, knowing look in the voice. She's been speaking about the same thing all along.
